reverse.rule: 205.6 holds when mean(P_you - P_reverse) >= 0.5 x mean(P_you - P_third)

G0.rule: mean option mass >= 0.5 and top token is a letter on >= half

G1.compared: full last-position logits, max absolute difference

G2.rule: mean(P_you - P_third) >= 0.10 over held-out SAY questions

G4.rule: min(Retest_SAY, Retest_DO) >= 20 of 80, each ranking separately

205.7.reason: no stage reads DO transfer and passes the random-set rule

205.8.gate: G0 or G4 at instruct or qwen-chat

withdrawal.headline: no stage creates sharing that this design can resolve

read_rules.O: read only where G0, G1 and G4 pass
read_rules.T: read only where G0, G1, G2 and G3 pass; every copy arm with it
read_rules.random_set_rule: at least two fillable families; exceeds every set in each fillable family
